build_DDPMModule: build a DDPModule wrapping a neural network with a DiscreteGaussianSchedule and Predictor for denoising diffusion
create_DDPMModule_forward_training: create a forward pass on DDPModule in training mode with timestep and conditional inputs
run_DDPMModule_forward_sampling: run DDPModule forward in eval mode to sample from the full diffusion schedule
test_DDPMModule_predict_parameters: test the predict_parameters method to compute mean and log_variance for a diffusion step
review_DDPMModule_remove_noise: review the remove_noise method that denoises corrupted data by one diffusion step
